research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: The Zebra is focused on developing a process for inferring insurability scores. This involves receiving requests for insurance comparison webpages and sending instructions to present webpages with user inputs. These inputs are configured to receive multiple user attributes, which are then used in dimensionality reduction of multi-attribute consumer profiles. This research aims to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of insurance comparisons by streamlining user data processing.

overview_description.description: The Zebra operates as an online insurance comparison marketplace. It provides rates and educational resources to inform consumers and help them find the coverage, service level, and pricing to suit their unique needs, while simultaneously helping insurance companies connect with the consumers they best serve in today’s digital world. It aims to simplify the process of finding and purchasing insurance by offering transparent and easy-to-understand options for car, home, and other types of insurance. The Zebra's platform allows users to input their information and receive personalized quotes, helping them find the best coverage and rates available.

about_short_description.short_description: The Zebra is an online insurance comparison platform providing real-time rates and educational resources for various insurance types.

product.name: The Zebra Insurance Comparison Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace that compares personalized insurance quotes, coverage options, and prices from multiple insurers, allowing consumers to purchase directly from a provider or through The Zebra.

product.name: Auto Insurance Quote Comparison
product.description: A service for comparing personalized car insurance rates and coverage from multiple insurers online, with options to purchase a policy or receive assistance from a licensed agent.

product.name: Home Insurance Quote Comparison
product.description: A service that compares homeowners insurance quotes, policy types, coverage limits, and deductibles from multiple providers based on a property’s characteristics and location.

product.name: Insurance Bundling Comparison
product.description: A comparison service for evaluating combined insurance policies, particularly auto and home or auto and renters coverage, from participating insurers.

product.name: Licensed Insurance Agent Assistance
product.description: Licensed agents provide guidance on insurance options, answer coverage questions, help compare policies, and assist customers with completing purchases or updating coverage.

identifier.value: Insurance Rate Tracking and Savings Tools

product.name: Insurance Rate Tracking and Savings Tools
product.description: Digital tools that estimate insurance costs, monitor rates, and provide alerts or guidance about potential price changes, discounts, renewals, and coverage decisions.
